name: og-02-reduced-carbon-to-protometabolism
title: The First Metabolism
question: Under continuous feed and washout, does a curated prebiotic reaction network persist and self-amplify as a connected system, rather than merely producing isolated organic molecules?
hypothesis: A curated graph (formate/acetate/pyruvate/glyoxylate + rTCA fragments) seeded with Muchowska/Moran edges sustains nonzero throughput and at least one autocatalytic motif within a feasible resource budget.
objective: Insert an experimentally-motivated reaction graph and test whether metabolism-like subnetworks emerge under flow.

findings.statement: The rTCA-fragment network sustains a nonzero net carbon throughput (~9e-4 mol/s) under continuous feed + washout, with no imposed product accumulation.
findings.explanation: Real libRoadRunner SBML CSTR — throughput is a steady balance of production and washout.

findings.statement: An autocatalytic motif emerges — the autocatalytic gain peaks at 29.5 (graded; settling lower as CO2 limits) via the lumped reductive-TCA turn; a no-CO2 control collapses it to 0.

evidence.observed: peak autocatalytic gain 29.5; no-CO2 control gain 0

findings.explanation: The reductive-TCA turn OAA+2CO2->2OAA+acetate doubles its own entry molecule per turn; the autocatalytic stoichiometry is a curated lumped reaction, so what is EMERGENT is that it sustains ignition under continuous feed + washout (a no-CO2 control collapses gain to 0), not the motif itself.

findings.statement: Products form ONE connected reaction network (networkx connectivity), not disconnected one-offs.

A sweep over (feed CO₂ × washout rate) maps where the network IGNITES, not just that it does at one point. The autocatalytic hub (OAA) persists in a sharply bounded region — enough geological CO₂ in, slow enough washout (gain > 1) — and collapses to zero across a clean diagonal boundary when the feed is starved or the reactor flushed too fast. The favorable operating point sits well inside the ignition region; the gain=1 contour is the autocatalytic threshold.

evidence.observed: OAA hub 0 → 24 mM across the (feed × washout) plane; ignition bounded by gain=1

findings.explanation: 16×16 sweep of the real libRoadRunner composite reduced to the settled OAA pool, net throughput and gain; rendered as the ignition phase map (Decision view). Runner sims/compute_gain_grid.py. Per-reaction fluxes are now read live from the engine (getReactionRates) so the network view is flux-weighted.

conclusion: A real SBML rTCA-fragment network sustains throughput and an autocatalytic motif under flow — reaction subnetworks become self-reinforcing, the metabolism-like emergence this study set out to test.

biological_validation.basis: Emergent sustained throughput + autocatalysis + connectivity, with a no-CO2 control collapsing them.

explanatory_gain.basis: The genuine libRoadRunner ODE network shows WHY autocatalysis arises (the reductive-TCA turn doubles OAA).

limitations: The reductive-TCA turn is a single lumped autocatalytic reaction, not the full multi-step cycle.
Fed from a fixed pyruvate/CO2 set-point rather than the live og-01 product stream.

resolved_uncertainties: A curated rTCA-fragment network under flow sustains throughput AND an autocatalytic motif.
remaining_uncertainties: Whether an acetyl-CoA-pathway arm cross-feeds or competes with the rTCA core.

followup_study_proposals.rationale: Add the acetyl-CoA-pathway fragments as a parallel arm and test cross-feeding.

implemented_methods: Module E — REAL libRoadRunner/Tellurium: a curated SBML rTCA-fragment network (pyruvate carboxylation + a lumped autocatalytic reductive-TCA turn OAA+2CO2 -> 2OAA+acetate + reductive branch to malate/succinate) run as a continuous-feed / washout CSTR, advanced each tick by the genuine roadrunner ODE integrator.

Emergent observables (not assumptions): net carbon throughput under feed+washout; the autocatalytic gain k_rtca.[CO2]/k_wash (>1 => a reinforcing motif is active; gain peaks ~29.5 then CO2-limits); networkx connectivity of the species-reaction graph (a single connected network). A no-CO2 control collapses flux + gain to 0.

key_assumptions: Rate laws/mineral dependencies carry provenance; autocatalysis is an emergent observable, not an assumption.
claim: Under continuous feed and washout the curated rTCA-fragment network sustains nonzero carbon throughput and an autocatalytic motif (OAA self-amplification, gain peaking near 29.5) inside a bounded ignition region, where enough feed and slow enough washout let the loop outpace dilution and past the gain = 1 boundary the hub washes out. It shows a specified protometabolic network persists under flow, while leaving open whether such motifs emerge from a broader, unconstrained reaction universe.
expert_questions: RESOLVED: started from rTCA fragments (reductive-TCA turn is the autocatalytic core); acetyl-CoA-pathway fragments are a natural parallel arm for a follow-up.
